_note: Published Teagasc figures run through kpi.summary / pl.net. Inputs are ANNUAL amounts; the test spreads each one over 12 calendar months in whole cents, remainder in December (the engine sums months back, ADR-0021). For every published figure the test asserts: engine result - published = the sum of `known_differences` for that figure, to the cent. Each difference names why the engine does not land on the published number (a definition the engine does not have yet, or a source table that does not add up). Changing a difference must be deliberate: it means the engine's definition, or the reading of the source, changed.

source.title: Teagasc National Farm Survey 2025 - Preliminary Results, Appendix 1, Dairying column
source.tables: Table 4 (printed p.12); Table 8C gross output (p.37); Table 8D direct and overhead costs (p.38); Table 8B resources (p.36)

mapping.milk: 8C 'of which milk' 311,767 = milk_litres x milk_price. Litres per farm are not published: milk_price is the published 54 c/l and milk_litres is chosen so the product is the published milk value. Per-litre results are therefore not asserted for this case.
mapping.cattle_sales: 8C Dairying livestock other than milk (337,883 - 311,767 = 26,116) + Cattle 53,215 + Sheep & wool 413 + Horses 222 = 79,966. NFS livestock output is sales - purchases +/- inventory change; the engine has no purchases or inventory lines here, so the net NFS figure is sent as sales.
mapping.other: 8C Crops 1,426 + Machinery hire revenue 3 + Other current receipts 790 = 2,219
mapping.fuel: 8D Machinery operating, of which fuel & lub 6,251
mapping.repairs_maintenance: 8D Machinery operating other than fuel (14,181 - 6,251 = 7,930) + Buildings maintenance 4,366 + Land improvement maintenance 3,842
mapping.other_operating_costs: 8D direct Crop protection 1,162 + Purchased seed 1,324 + Other direct 16,791, and overhead Other 10,151
mapping.stock_closing_value: 8D Fodder crop adjustment -1,570 (closing fodder above opening): sent as a stock value increase of 1,570

gross_output.reason: Inter-enterprise transfers (8C) are deducted by the NFS to avoid double counting (e.g. milk fed to calves); the engine has no such line.
Source: the 8C gross output lines less transfers add to 410,757, not the published 407,372; the report does not explain the gap.
Fodder crop adjustment: the NFS deducts it from direct costs, the engine adds it to gross output as a stock value change (same family farm income).

direct_costs.reason: Crop protection 1,162, purchased seed 1,324 and other direct costs 16,791 have no variable line in the engine and sit in other_operating_costs, a fixed cost (proposal E4: seed_spray, ai_breeding, milk_recording_parlour lines).
Fodder crop adjustment reduces NFS direct costs; the engine carries it in gross output instead.
Source: the ten published direct cost lines add to 151,701, the published sub-total is 151,730.

overhead_costs.reason: The NFS direct costs the engine counts as fixed (see direct_costs).
Source: the published overhead lines add to 103,848, the published total is 103,894.

family_farm_income.reason: Unexplained gap in the published gross output lines (see gross_output).
Direct cost lines add to 29 less than the published sub-total.
Overhead lines add to 46 less than the published total.
Source rounding: published direct 150,160 + overheads 103,894 = 254,054, published total costs 254,053.
